description: A multi-profile claim (composition of coupled ODE subsystems) auto-classifies to dynamics, executable_ode_dae_sde_model, and model_composition. The plan is a 3-step DAG among the applicable profiles: model_composition depends on dynamics and executable_ode_dae_sde_model (its inputs come from their outputs), in topological order. With the shipped catalog (all adapters future/remote_required), all three are WAIT_CAPABILITY (adapterless -> honest wait); the DAG structure (depends_on edges) is still threaded so a future WP that lands adapters produces a runnable topological order.

claim.statement: We study the composition of coupled ODE subsystems forming a hierarchical model.
